scope: Synthetic evaluation only. No diagnosis, hormone inference or clinical validity.
selection: Existing train/validation pipeline unchanged. No test-based parameter or threshold choice. Earlier seeds are development evidence.
execution: One guarded run. Keep raw predictions and model artifacts. Do not overwrite/retry after results have been inspected.

reporting_followups.standard_average_precision: Replace the tie-sensitive summary using stored predictions; retain the legacy result and log the intentional change.
reporting_followups.calibration_slope_intercept: Diagnostic regression on held-out logits only; never feed fitted diagnostic coefficients into inference.

sequential_policy.rule: Earliest eligible validation-threshold crossing, safety evaluated at that snapshot, at most one alert. No later snapshot may change an earlier decision.
sequential_policy.exposure: Sum of generated cycle lengths / 365.25 patient-years; not a clinical annual risk estimate.
sequential_policy.lead_time: Generated ovulation day minus alert day among true-positive cycles with present ovulation. Absent ovulation has no numerical event-day lead time.

robustness.archetype_shift: Train and calibrate without one archetype, then evaluate only that archetype. Report every archetype, without selecting a favorable exclusion.

bayesian_twin.hypotheses: Ovulation day 1..45 or absent, using the generator's event-day convention.
bayesian_twin.prior: Train-fitted calendar/static prior for timing and absence, no dynamic test labels.
bayesian_twin.likelihood: Train-only pre/post-event Gaussian temperature, RHR and HRV parameters. Skip missing observations. Fixed likelihood temperature of one.
bayesian_twin.primary_comparison: Day-18 Tier-2, patient-cluster CI for twin Brier minus logistic Brier. Promote only if the upper 95% bound is at most the predeclared margin. Otherwise retain the twin as an interpretation layer.

ehr_lab.construction: Positive normalized proxy exp(latent) times independent mean-one log-normal assay noise with CV 0.15. These are simulated assay-like indices, not measured hormones or actual HOMA-IR.
ehr_lab.comparison: Keep the original simulator-internal tier explicitly as an upper-bound reference. New lab-like analysis is a post-freeze extension, not an untouched frozen-v1 primary endpoint.

ops.units: milliseconds and KiB; report full-process peak RSS separately

conformal.selection: One uniformly selected cycle per independent calibration patient, with an independent selection RNG. Unique calibration seed per model seed/tier/day: 300000 + model_seed*10000 + tier*100 + day.
conformal.day_band: Conditional on generated ovulation being present. Report empirical frozen coverage overall and by archetype; no individual or clinical guarantee.

date_fix: Later chain true cycle starts by generated cycle length without changing any RNG draw or classifier input; retain classification regression tests.
